criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 1 January 2028 (180 days after the 5 July 2027 Prospectus date).
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 23 June 2027 is 12 days before the 5 July 2027 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies the undisclosed $2,500,000 interest-free loan to director Leila Bhattacharya that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (180 days) and a date (1 January 2028), with days remaining from 17 June 2027 (198 days).
Notes that 1 January 2028 is a Saturday and identifies the next Business Day, 3 January 2028, as the first trading opportunity.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
